words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ

hindi: वेतन लेकर कर्म न करने वाले भृतक का बारह पण का दण्ड है, और कर्म करने तक संरोध।
english: For a hired worker who, having taken pay, does not do the work, the penalty is twelve paṇas, and confinement until the doing.
notes: karma = work (ch. 14 deals with hired work). saṃrodha = confinement/detention, literal. 'ā-karaṇāt' = up to the doing (of the work). Verbless clauses; copula supplied only as a bare 'is'.
lines_deva: गृहीत्वा वेतनं कर्म-अकुर्वतो भृतकस्य द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, संरोधश् च-आ.करणात्
lines_iast: gṛhītvā vetanaṃ karma-akurvato bhṛtakasya dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, saṃrodhaś ca-ā.karaṇāt

hindi: असमर्थ निन्दित कर्म में, रोग में या व्यसन में अनुशय पा सकता है, अथवा दूसरे से करवाने को पा सकता है।
english: One who is unable, in despised work, in illness or in calamity, may obtain anuśaya, or [may obtain] to have [it] done by another.
notes: anuśaya = regret, literal; the sense is probably release from (rescinding of) the engagement, uncertain. vyasane = calamity (personal misfortune), not the king's vice. 'labheta' is repeated in thought with 'kārayitum' (to have it done by another). Subject (the hired worker) not stated in the Sanskrit.
lines_deva: अशक्तः कुत्सिते कर्मणि व्याधौ व्यसने वा-अनुशयं लभेत, परेण वा कारयितुम्
lines_iast: aśaktaḥ kutsite karmaṇi vyādhau vyasane vā-anuśayaṃ labheta, pareṇa vā kārayitum

hindi: अथवा भर्ता उसके व्यय और कर्म द्वारा करवाने को पा सकता है।
english: Or the employer may obtain to have [it] done by means of his expenditure and work.

text_flags.why: possible: 'tasya' is an inflected pronoun, not a compound member (cf. unit 16 'tasya-atikrame'); '.' after it is probably a slip for '-' or a space, so 'tasya' + 'vyaya-karmaṇā'

notes: The compound tasya.vyaya.karmaṇā is doubtful: 'by his (the worker's) expenditure and work', or 'by the work of his expenditure'; 'his' may also be the employer's. Rendered literally; the sense (employer has the work done at the worker's cost) is not applied.
lines_deva: तस्य.व्यय.कर्मणा लभेत भर्ता वा कारयितुम्
lines_iast: tasya.vyaya.karmaṇā labheta bhartā vā kārayitum

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ caus.
m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ

hindi: “तुम्हारे द्वारा दूसरा करवाया नहीं जाना चाहिए, या मेरे द्वारा दूसरे के लिए किया नहीं जाना चाहिए”, इस रोक में भर्ता के न करवाने पर अथवा भृतक के न करने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: When, under the restriction “No other is to be made to do [it] by you, or [it] is not to be done by me for another”, the employer does not have [it] done or the hired worker does not do [it], the penalty is twelve paṇas.
notes: avarodhe (loc.) = in the restriction/confinement; literal, sense of an exclusive-service stipulation is inferred from the quotation. The closing iti only closes the quotation and is not rendered. Objects of kārayitavyaḥ/kartavyam not stated (the work is implied).
lines_deva: "न-अन्यस् त्वया कारयितव्यो, मया वा न-अन्यस्य कर्तव्यम्" इत्य् अवरोधे भर्तुर् अकारयतो भृतकस्य-अकुर्वतो वा द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: "na-anyas tvayā kārayitavyo, mayā vā na-anyasya kartavyam" ity avarodhe bhartur akārayato bhṛtakasya-akurvato vā dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: in the completion of the work

hindi: कर्म की समाप्ति में भर्ता को छोड़कर, जिसने वेतन ले लिया है, इच्छा के बिना न करे।
english: In the completion of the work, one who has taken pay should not do [it] except [for] the employer, without [his] wish.
notes: Doubtful. 'bhartur anyatra' could be 'elsewhere than with the employer' or 'other than the employer'. 'na asakāmaḥ' (a-sa-kāma, without wish) is rendered 'without [his] wish', whose wish (employer's or the worker's) is not stated; an alternative reading is 'not unwilling'. The same phrase recurs in unit 10.
lines_deva: कर्म.निष्ठापने भर्तुर् अन्यत्र गृहीत.वेतनो न-असकामः कुर्यात्
lines_iast: karma.niṣṭhāpane bhartur anyatra gṛhīta.vetano na-asakāmaḥ kuryāt

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ caus.

hindi: “उपस्थित को न करवाने वाले का किया हुआ ही जाने”, ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Of one who does not have [it] done when [it is] presented, [one] should know [it] indeed as done,” say the teachers.
notes: Formula 'X iti ācāryāḥ' per glossary. upasthitam (n.) is presented/ready; its noun (the work) is not stated. The person who 'should know' is not stated.
lines_deva: "उपस्थितम् अकारयतः कृतम् एव विद्याद्" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: "upasthitam akārayataḥ kṛtam eva vidyād" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: किए हुए का वेतन है, न किए हुए का नहीं है।
english: There is pay for what is done; for what is not done there is none.
notes: 'asti' is shared: vetanam [asti] kṛtasya, na akṛtasya asti.
lines_deva: कृतस्य वेतनं न-अकृतस्य-अस्ति
lines_iast: kṛtasya vetanaṃ na-akṛtasya-asti

hindi: यदि वह थोड़ा भी करवाकर न करवाए, इसका किया हुआ ही जाने।
english: If he, having had even a little done, does not have [more] done, [one] should know [it] indeed as done of his.
notes: Unstated: who 'he' is (the employer, by context) and whose 'asya' is; 'of his' kept literal. 'ced' = cet.
lines_deva: स चेद् अल्पम् अपि कारयित्वा न कारयेत् कृतम् एव-अस्य विद्यात्
lines_iast: sa ced alpam api kārayitvā na kārayet kṛtam eva-asya vidyāt

hindi: देश और काल के अतिक्रमण से, अथवा कर्मों के अन्यथा किए जाने पर, इच्छा के बिना किया हुआ न माने।
english: Through overstepping of place and time, or when the works are done otherwise, [one] should not accept [it] as done, without [his] wish.
notes: Same na-asakāmaḥ phrase as unit 5, same doubt (whose wish; or 'not unwilling' with the opposite sense). Subject of anumanyeta not stated (the employer by context).
lines_deva: देश.काल.अतिपातनेन कर्मणाम् अन्यथा.करणे वा न-असकामः कृतम् अनुमन्येत
lines_iast: deśa.kāla.atipātanena karmaṇām anyathā.karaṇe vā na-asakāmaḥ kṛtam anumanyeta

hindi: बातचीत में तय किए गए से अधिक किए जाने पर प्रयास को निष्फल न करे।
english: When more is done than what was agreed, [one] should not make the effort vain.
notes: Subject not stated (the employer by context).
lines_deva: सम्भाषिताद् अधिक.क्रियायां प्रयासं न मोघं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: sambhāṣitād adhika.kriyāyāṃ prayāsaṃ na moghaṃ kuryāt

hindi: इससे संघ-भृतों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, those hired in a group (saṅgha) are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ'. saṅgha here = a group (cf. glossary 4.5), not the political saṅgha; saṅgha-bhṛta read 'hired as a group'. 'bhṛtā vyākhyātāḥ' is regular sandhi (-āḥ before v).
lines_deva: तेन सङ्घ.भृता व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: tena saṅgha.bhṛtā vyākhyātāḥ

hindi: उनका बन्धक सात रात तक रहे।
english: Their pledge should remain for seven nights.
notes: ādhi = pledge (also 'anxiety' in other usage); sense uncertain here, rendered as pledge (cf. glossary 4.1 ādhāna). Alternatively 'waiting' (āsīta from √ās 'sit, remain').
lines_deva: तेषाम् आधिः सप्त.रात्रम् आसीत
lines_iast: teṣām ādhiḥ sapta.rātram āsīta

hindi: तब दूसरे को उपस्थित कराए, और कर्म की पूर्ति।
english: Then [one] should provide another, and the completion of the work.
notes: Elliptical: 'ca' joins niṣpākam to the object of upasthāpayet; a verb such as 'bring about' is not supplied. Subject (the group) not stated.
lines_deva: ततो ऽन्यम् उपस्थापयेत्, कर्म.निष्पाकं च
lines_iast: tato 'nyam upasthāpayet, karma.niṣpākaṃ ca

hindi: और भर्ता को सूचित किए बिना संघ किसी को न हटाए, अथवा न लाए।
english: And the group should not, without informing the employer, leave out or bring in anyone.
notes: 'bhartuḥ' with anivedya is genitive in the text (employer, as the one informed). parihṛ = leave out/exclude, literal (cf. parihāra 'exemption' in 13.5); the negative governs both verbs.
lines_deva: न च-अनिवेद्य भर्तुः सङ्घः कञ्चित् परिहरेद् उपनयेद् वा
lines_iast: na ca-anivedya bhartuḥ saṅghaḥ kañcit parihared upanayed vā

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर चौबीस पण का दण्ड है।
english: In transgression of that, the penalty is twenty-four paṇas.
lines_deva: तस्य-अतिक्रमे चतुर्.विंशति.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: tasya-atikrame catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: संघ द्वारा हटाए गए का आधा दण्ड। यह भृतक-अधिकार है।
english: For one left out by the group, half the penalty. Such is the section on hired workers.

text_flags.why: embedded verse number and bars inside the text; not Sanskrit words

notes: The edition's own number '17' with danda marks stands inside the line (end of the first section of the chapter); kept as printed. Closing 'iti X' label rendered 'Such [is] X' per glossary (3.7, 9.3). adhikāra = section/topic heading, literal. GROUPING: the printed '| 17 |' is an embedded verse number plus separators inside the unit; the closing label 'iti bhṛtaka-adhikāraḥ' (section title) follows it and belongs to the section, not to the sentence. The three marker words are not Sanskrit words.
lines_deva: सङ्घेन परिहृतस्य-अर्ध.दण्डः । १७ । इति भृतक.अधिकारः
lines_iast: saṅghena parihṛtasya-ardha.daṇḍaḥ | 17 | iti bhṛtaka.adhikāraḥ

words.gloss: those who rise up together after combining

hindi: संघ-भृत, अथवा मिलकर साथ उठ खड़े होने वाले, जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ वैसा अथवा बराबर वेतन बाँट लें।
english: Those hired in a group, or those who rise up together after combining, should divide the pay as agreed, or equally.
notes: sambhūya-samutthātṛ = 'those who undertake together after combining' (cf. glossary 8.2 sāmutthāyika); partners/associates is the likely sense, kept literal.
lines_deva: सङ्घ.भृताः सम्भूय.समुत्थातारो वा यथा.सम्भाषितं वेतनं समं वा विभजेरन्
lines_iast: saṅgha.bhṛtāḥ sambhūya.samutthātāro vā yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vetanaṃ samaṃ vā vibhajeran

words.gloss: in the interval between the start and the end of crops and wares

hindi: अथवा कृषि करने वाले और वैदेहक, फसल और माल के आरम्भ और समाप्ति के बीच डूबे हुए के जैसे किए गए कर्म के अनुरूप अंश दें।
english: Or cultivators and traders should give a corresponding share for the work as done of one who has sunk, in the interval between the start and the end of the crops and wares.
notes: karṣaṇa-vaidehakāḥ: cultivators (literally 'cultivation') and traders (vaidehaka, as 8.4 'trader'). sanna (√sad) = sunk, i.e. one who has given way or failed; the exact sense is not applied. The compound 'sasya-paṇya-ārambha-paryavasāna-antare' is read 'in the interval of the start and the end of the (undertaking of) crops and wares'.
lines_deva: कर्षण.वैदेहका वा सस्य.पण्य.आरम्भ.पर्यवसान.अन्तरे सन्नस्य यथा.कृतस्य कर्मणः प्रत्यंशं दद्युः
lines_iast: karṣaṇa.vaidehakā vā sasya.paṇya.ārambha.paryavasāna.antare sannasya yathā.kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ pratyaṃśaṃ dadyuḥ

words.gloss: on the presenting of a man

hindi: पुरुष के उपस्थित किए जाने पर पूरा अंश दें।
english: On the presenting of a man, they should give the whole share.
notes: puruṣa-upasthāna = presenting of a man (a substitute is probably meant); kept literal. Subject (those of unit 19) not restated.
lines_deva: पुरुष.उपस्थाने समग्रम् अंशं दद्युः
lines_iast: puruṣa.upasthāne samagram aṃśaṃ dadyuḥ

words.gloss: when the wares are taken out

hindi: किन्तु सिद्ध हो जाने पर, माल निकाल लिए जाने पर उसी समय डूबे हुए का अनुरूप अंश दें।
english: But when [it is] accomplished, the wares [being] taken out, they should give the corresponding share of one who has sunk at that very time.
notes: uddhṛta = taken out/ extracted; the sense (wares removed, i.e. realised) kept literal.
lines_deva: संसिद्धे तु-उद्धृत.पण्ये सन्नस्य तदानीम् एव प्रत्यंशं दद्युः
lines_iast: saṃsiddhe tu-uddhṛta.paṇye sannasya tadānīm eva pratyaṃśaṃ dadyuḥ

hindi: क्योंकि मार्ग में सिद्धि और असिद्धि साझी है।
english: For success and failure on the way are shared.
notes: sāmānyā agrees with both nouns (read as 'sāmānye' in strict grammar); 'on the way' may govern both nouns. 'sāmānya' = common/shared.
lines_deva: सामान्या हि पथि.सिद्धिश् च-असिद्धिश् च
lines_iast: sāmānyā hi pathi.siddhiś ca-asiddhiś ca

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. apa-√kram

hindi: किन्तु कर्म आरम्भ हो जाने पर स्वस्थ होते हुए हट जाने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: But when the work has begun, [there is] a penalty of twelve paṇas for one who, [though] healthy, leaves.
lines_deva: प्रक्रान्ते तु कर्मणि स्वस्थस्य-अपक्रामतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: prakrānte tu karmaṇi svasthasya-apakrāmato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: और हट जाने में इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता नहीं है।
english: And [there is] no freedom of will in leaving.
notes: prākāmya = freedom of will (glossary 4.12); the sense is that the worker may not leave at will.
lines_deva: न च प्राकाम्यम् अपक्रमणे
lines_iast: na ca prākāmyam apakramaṇe

hindi: किन्तु चोर को अभयपूर्वक कर्म के अनुरूप अंश के द्वारा पकड़वाए; अनुरूप अंश और अभय दे।
english: But a thief, with assurance of safety first, [one] should cause to be seized by a corresponding share of the work; [one] should give the corresponding share and safety.
notes: Doubtful. grāhayet kept literal 'cause to be seized' (glossary 9.6); the sense may be 'make [him] accept/take part' or 'secure [him]'. Subjects not stated. 'abhaya-pūrvam' = with safety (assurance) given first.
lines_deva: चोरं त्व् अभय.पूर्वं कर्मणः प्रत्यंशेन ग्राहयेद्, दद्यात् प्रत्यंशम् अभयं च
lines_iast: coraṃ tv abhaya.pūrvaṃ karmaṇaḥ pratyaṃśena grāhayed, dadyāt pratyaṃśam abhayaṃ ca

hindi: फिर से चोरी करने पर निर्वासन, और अन्यत्र जाने में।
english: For theft again, banishment; and in going elsewhere.
notes: The second phrase is elliptical (the same penalty is presumably meant) and is left open.
lines_deva: पुनः.स्तेये प्रवासनम्, अन्यत्र.गमने च
lines_iast: punaḥ.steye pravāsanam, anyatra.gamane ca

hindi: किन्तु महान् अपराध में दूष्य के समान आचरण करे।
english: But in a great offence, [one] should act as with the treasonable.
notes: dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary); 'dūṣyavat' = like a dūṣya; here 'tainted/guilty person' is possible. Subject not stated.
lines_deva: महा.अपराधे तु दूष्यवद् आचरेत्
lines_iast: mahā.aparādhe tu dūṣyavad ācaret

hindi: याजक स्व-प्रचार द्रव्य को छोड़कर जैसा बातचीत में तय हुआ वैसा अथवा बराबर वेतन बाँट लें।
english: The officiating priests should divide the pay as agreed, or equally, excluding the sva-pracāra things.

text_flags.why: possible: 'svā' may be sva+apracāra fused, or a typo for sva; the sense of 'svā-pracāra' is unclear

notes: The compound svā-pracāra-dravya is obscure and kept untranslated (possibly 'things of own use/currency', or sva-apracāra 'own non-use'); no sense is asserted. Hindi and English keep 'svā-pracāra'. Also pay (vetanam) here is the priests' fee. Reviewer: w, Hindi and English use the corrected sva-pracāra (see text_flags); the printed form is svā-pracāra.
lines_deva: याजकाः स्वा.प्रचार.द्रव्य.वर्जं यथा.सम्भाषितं वेतनं समं वा विभजेरन्
lines_iast: yājakāḥ svā.pracāra.dravya.varjaṃ yathā.sambhāṣitaṃ vetanaṃ samaṃ vā vibhajeran

words.gloss: in those beginning with the Agnishtoma

hindi: और अग्निष्टोम आदि यज्ञों में दीक्षण के बाद तीसरा अंश, मध्यम उपसद् के बाद आधा अंश, सुत्य में प्रातःसवन के बाद चौथाई कम अंश।
english: And in sacrifices beginning with the Agnishtoma, [they receive] a third share after the initiation, a half share after the middle upasad, [and] at the pressing, after the morning pressing, a share less a quarter.
notes: Verbless; the verb is supplied in brackets in English only. 'ca' joins this to unit 28. sutye read as loc. of sutya (the pressing day); upasad and savana are ritual stages kept as terms.
lines_deva: अग्निष्टोम.आदिषु च क्रतुषु दीक्षणाद् ऊर्ध्वं तृतीयम् अंशं, मध्यम.उपसद ऊर्ध्वम् अर्धम् अंशं, सुत्ये प्रातः.सवनाद् ऊर्ध्वं पाद.ऊनम् अंशम्
lines_iast: agniṣṭoma.ādiṣu ca kratuṣu dīkṣaṇād ūrdhvaṃ tṛtīyam aṃśaṃ, madhyama.upasada ūrdhvam ardham aṃśaṃ, sutye prātaḥ.savanād ūrdhvaṃ pāda.ūnam aṃśam

hindi: माध्यन्दिन सवन के बाद पूरा अंश पाए।
english: After the midday pressing, [one] may obtain the whole share.
notes: Subject not stated (the priest by context).
lines_deva: माध्यन्दिनात् सवनाद् ऊर्ध्वं समग्रम् अंशं लभेत
lines_iast: mādhyandināt savanād ūrdhvaṃ samagram aṃśaṃ labheta

hindi: क्योंकि दक्षिणाएँ लाई हुई हो जाती हैं।
english: For the fees become brought.
notes: nītā hi dakṣiṇā = nītāḥ hi dakṣiṇāḥ (regular sandhi, -āḥ before voiced). nītā (√nī, lead/bring) literal; the sense is probably that the fees are brought/given at each pressing (cf. unit 32). Doubtful.
lines_deva: नीता हि दक्षिणा भवन्ति
lines_iast: nītā hi dakṣiṇā bhavanti

hindi: क्योंकि बृहस्पतिसव को छोड़कर प्रत्येक सवन में दक्षिणाएँ दी जाती हैं।
english: For, excluding the Brihaspati-sava, the fees are given at each pressing.
notes: Brihaspati-sava is the name of a rite, kept as a name. 'dakṣiṇā dīyante' = dakṣiṇāḥ dīyante (sandhi).
lines_deva: बृहस्पति.सव.वर्जं प्रतिसवनं हि दक्षिणा दीयन्ते
lines_iast: bṛhaspati.sava.varjaṃ pratisavanaṃ hi dakṣiṇā dīyante

hindi: इससे अहर्गण की दक्षिणाओं की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the fees of the ahargaṇa (literally 'group of days') are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ'. ahargaṇa kept as a term (a sacrificial type spread over a series of days); no further sense is asserted.
lines_deva: तेन-अहर्.गण.दक्षिणा व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: tena-ahar.gaṇa.dakṣiṇā vyākhyātāḥ

words.gloss: up to ten days and nights

hindi: सत्रों के दस अहोरात्र तक शेष के लिए रखे गए भृतक कर्म करें, अथवा दूसरे अपने विश्वास के।
english: Of the sessions, up to ten days and nights, those hired for the remainder should do the work, or others of their own trust.

text_flags.why: possible: 'sanānām' has no sense; 'satrāṇām' (of sattra sessions) fits the sacrificial context

notes: Doubtful. sattra (session) is a restored reading (see text_flags). 'ā-daśa-aho-rātrāt' = up to ten day-and-night periods. śeṣa-bhṛta = hired for the remainder (bhṛta read as 'hired', cf. glossary 9.2). sva-pratyaya = of own trust/reliance, obscure.
lines_deva: सनानाम् आ.दश.अहो.रात्रात्-शेष.भृताः कर्म कुर्युः, अन्ये वा स्व.प्रत्ययाः
lines_iast: sanānām ā.daśa.aho.rātrāt-śeṣa.bhṛtāḥ karma kuryuḥ, anye vā sva.pratyayāḥ

hindi: किन्तु कर्म के पूरा न होने पर यजमान डूबे, ऋत्विज कर्म पूरा करवाकर दक्षिणा ले लें।
english: But when the work is not completed, the sacrificer would sink; the priests, having had the work completed, should take the fee.
notes: sīdet (√sad) = sink, i.e. suffer/be at a loss; kept literal. 'karmaṇy asamāpte' = karmaṇi asamāpte (loc. absolute).
lines_deva: कर्मण्य् असमाप्ते तु यजमानः सीदेद्, ऋत्विजः कर्म समापय्य दक्षिणां हरेयुः
lines_iast: karmaṇy asamāpte tu yajamānaḥ sīded, ṛtvijaḥ karma samāpayya dakṣiṇāṃ hareyuḥ

words.gloss: the one for whom one sacrifices

hindi: किन्तु कर्म के पूरा न होने पर याज्य या याजक को छोड़ने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: But when the work is not completed, for one abandoning the yājya or the priest, [there is] the first fine for rashness.
notes: yājya = the one for whom the sacrifice is performed. 'pūrvaḥ sāhasa-daṇḍaḥ' = first fine for rashness (glossary 4.11).
lines_deva: असमाप्ते तु कर्मणि याज्यं याजकं वा त्यजतः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: asamāpte tu karmaṇi yājyaṃ yājakaṃ vā tyajataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

words.gloss: one who has not established the fire
one who goes to the guru's bed

hindi: जिसने अग्नि स्थापित नहीं की, सौ गायों वाला, यज्ञ न करने वाला और हज़ार गायों वाला; सुरा पीने वाला, वृषली का पति, ब्रह्महत्यारा, गुरु की शय्या पर जाने वाला।
english: One who has not established the fire, one having a hundred cows, the non-sacrificer, and one having a thousand cows; the drinker of surā, the husband of a vṛṣalī, the killer of a Brahmin, one who goes to the guru's bed.

text_flags.why: possible: 'śata-guḥ ayajvā' (owner of a hundred cows, non-sacrificer) pairs with 'sahasra-guḥ'; 'guru' looks like gur + a-

notes: List of nominatives continued in unit 38; the sentence is one statement across the two verses. The reading 'śata-guḥ ayajvā' is conjectural (see text_flags); as printed, 'śata.guru.yajvā' would be 'a sacrificer with a hundred (very) heavy', which does not fit. The grouping of 'ayajvā' with the hundred or the thousand cows is uncertain. vṛṣalī kept as a word (a woman of low class, literally); brahma-hā rendered 'killer of a Brahmin' (brahma = brāhmaṇa).
lines_deva: अनाहित.अग्निः शत.गुरु.यज्वा च सहस्रगुः
सुरापो वृषली.भर्ता ब्रह्महा गुरु.तल्पगः
lines_iast: anāhita.agniḥ śata.guru.yajvā ca sahasraguḥ
surāpo vṛṣalī.bhartā brahmahā guru.talpagaḥ

words.gloss: from the certainty of the mixing of the works

hindi: बुरे प्रतिग्रह में लगा हुआ, चोर, निन्दित याजक; एक-दूसरे को छोड़ने में दोष नहीं है, कर्मों के सङ्कर के निश्चय से।
english: One engaged in bad acceptance, a thief, a despised priest: [there is] no fault in abandoning one another, because of the certainty of the mixing of the works.
notes: Continues unit 37. asat-pratigraha = acceptance of the bad (taking gifts improperly); literal sense 'bad acceptance' (cf. glossary 8.3 asat-pragraha). The sense that priest and sacrificer may abandon one another without fault is inferred from context; 'adoṣaḥ' agrees with no stated noun. karma-saṅkara = mixing (confusion) of the works.
lines_deva: असत्.प्रतिग्रहे युक्तः स्तेनः कुत्सित.याजकः
अदोषस् त्यक्तुम् अन्योन्यं कर्म.सङ्कर.निश्चयात्
lines_iast: asat.pratigrahe yuktaḥ stenaḥ kutsita.yājakaḥ
adoṣas tyaktum anyonyaṃ karma.saṅkara.niścayāt
